info.title: Fenders management API
info.description: The workspace API, which a workspace's key is given, and the operator's routes, which no key is. Deployment/start never invokes a command. Same-key retries return the original operation; command outcomes are observed separately. A key is issued, listed and revoked with the operator credential (/tenants/{tenant}/api-keys), never with a key; it may carry a label, which GET /me returns and the audit trail records.

tags.name: workspace
tags.description: What a workspace's key may be given. The operator credential may call these too.

tags.name: operator
tags.description: The operator's own routes. No key is ever given one: a key that asks is answered 403.

get.description: Required permission: read. One timeline, newest first: each HTTP, manual or scheduled invocation is one entry (entry=run, as in List runs) interleaved with recorded lifecycle changes (entry=lifecycle). Command admission and execution transitions are summarized by their invocation unless type=lifecycle or a release, run or execution filter is set; those filters list recorded transitions only. Lifecycle changes and HTTP requests are retained for 30 days.

parameters.description: Omit for everything. lifecycle lists every recorded transition; http, manual and schedule list only those invocations (schedule includes explicit schedule tests). Ignored with a release, run or execution filter.

post.summary: Send one request to an HTTP app
post.description: Makes one request of the app through the gateway, as a client of its URL would, and reports what came back. It is admitted, counted and charged as any request of the app is. The answer is 200 whatever the app or the gateway said; read outcome. Required permission: runs:write.

200.description: What became of the request.

get.summary: Find a deployment by its request's key
get.description: The operation of POST …/apps/deploy made with this key. Asks after a request whose answer was lost. 404 does not show that the request failed: it may still be in flight. Required permission: read.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The Idempotency-Key the request was made with, percent-encoded as a path segment: a key with a slash or a space in it is found as %2F and %20.

apiKey.description: Workspace API key. Permissions and optional project scope are enforced on every request. The operator credential is accepted wherever a key is.

operator.description: The operator credential, written to STATE/operator.token at first start. Not scoped: it may call every route, a workspace's among them.

error.description: For a person to read. Its wording may change; branch on code.

code.description: Why the request was refused, for a program to branch on. Either the status named, or a reason more specific than it. Codes may be added.

Record.description: Observed resource fields; read-only fields may be added. See the reference and examples.

concurrency.description: Requests one HTTP execution serves at once; each has the size's linear memory, so they must fit it together.

websocket.description: Accept WebSocket connections at the app's URL. Fenders holds each connection and sends the app its events as POST requests to /_fenders/ws/connect, /_fenders/ws/message and /_fenders/ws/disconnect, with the connection's id in the fenders-connection header; the app's executions send to a connection with POST http://fenders.internal/v1/run/ws/ID, close it with DELETE, and list the open ones with GET http://fenders.internal/v1/run/ws.

scale.description: How many executions serve the app's HTTP requests: at least min (none while idle when 0), more under load up to max.

trigger_time.description: source=test-schedule only: one of the schedule's own times, recorded in the last 30 days or one of the next five. The command receives it as FENDERS_TRIGGER_TIME. Defaults to the submission time.

HttpSample.description: One request to make of the app through the gateway. An empty object asks for GET /.

path.description: Origin form: it starts with one slash and has no fragment.

body.description: At most 64 KiB; none for GET and HEAD.

HttpSampleResult.description: What became of a sample request. outcome is response when the app answered, refused when the gateway did not hand it to the app, and unconfirmed when it was handed over and no answer came back.

body.description: outcome=response: the first 16 KiB of the body, base64.

body_bytes.description: outcome=response: how much of the body was read, at most 1 MiB.

truncated.description: outcome=response: whether body is less than the app sent.

gateway_status.description: outcome=refused or unconfirmed: the status a client of the app would have been given.

Allowance.description: What a workspace may use. Always given whole.

cpu_percent.description: CPU its runs may hold at once, in hundredths of a core.

transfer_bytes.description: Outbound and gateway transfer in a UTC month.

WorkspaceUpdate.description: At least one of the two.

name.description: A label. Two workspaces may share one; the id is what identifies.

lifecycle_revision.description: The operator's alone: what POST …/lifecycle expects.

HttpLimits.description: How many requests of a workspace's HTTP apps may be in flight at once, and how many admitted in a minute.

request_key.description: The Idempotency-Key, as it was once sent. Send the header.

status.description: suspending until the workspace's executions have ended.

permissions.description: projects:write is not given to a key of one project.

label.description: One line the issuer wants recorded with what the key does. Not interpreted.

prefix.description: The start of the token, to tell keys apart by.
The start of the token, to tell keys apart by.

anyOf.description: Shown once and not kept. null when replayed.

replayed.description: true for a retry: nothing was issued, and no token can be shown. If the first answer was lost, revoke the key by its id and issue another.

cert_sha256.description: The pin of the node's certificate.
The pin of the node's certificate.

NodeMode.description: At least one. What is not named is left as it is.

NodeModeResult.description: What was asked, with the node's id.

anyOf.description: The digest of the policy this control plane was started with, or null when it has none.

pending_executions.description: Executions with public HTTPS access still to be stopped.

ControlPlaneStatus.description: How this control plane's own loops are doing. A loop that runs is not proof that work is placed.
